title: Your first subscriber
description: A sensor publishes repeatedly. Subscribe to /scan and inspect the range samples arriving in your callback. In this fixed KineNest scan, ray 60 happens to face forward. In 2.3 you will calculate directions from angle metadata.
steps: Inspect /scan with topic type and echo --once.
Create a LaserScan subscription and print the number of beams and the forward range.
Run it, observe repeated output, and inspect the subscription using ros2 topic info /scan.
hints: A subscription callback takes the received message as its argument.
This 120-ray scan starts at −π; ray 60 points forward.

Python: node.create_subscription(LaserScan, "/scan", receive, 10) · C++: scan_ = create_subscription<sensor_msgs::msg::LaserScan>("/scan", 10, [this](sensor_msgs::msg::LaserScan::SharedPtr msg) { receive(msg); });
